paragraphs.text: Adds a one-click prompt-rewrite button to the DeepSeek Harness chat composer.
# dsh-qoder-input
A DeepSeek Harness composer plugin: a one-click prompt-rewrite button for the chat input.
给 DeepSeek Harness 的聊天输入框加一个「✨ 增强提示词」按钮。
## ⚠️ Compatibility / 兼容性警告
**Read this before installing. / 装之前请先读完这一段。**

- Tested on **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.3** (Electron 44.7.0, Windows).
- This plugin uses **undocum

ented host APIs** that are not part of a stable public contract:
- composer slots `conversation.inpu

t.right`, `conversation.input.overlay`
- the `useInput` selector hook and `inputActions.setDraft`
-

`ctx.connection.fetch.register` for the two local routes
- `ctx.llm` for the rewrite call
- DSH boot
s **all-or-nothing**: if one plugin fails to activate, the whole app refuses to start. So on an inco

mpatible DSH version this plugin may make DSH **unable to launch**.
- 本插件使用宿主的**未公开内部接口**。DSH 启动是「全有
或全无」：任一插件激活失败会导致整个应用无法启动。升级 DSH 后本插件可能失效，极端情况下会导致 DSH 打不开。
### If DSH stops launching after enabling this plugin / 启用后打不开怎么办
Edit `~/.dsh/profiles/<your-profile>/package.json` and remove the two `dsh-qoder-input` lines:

1. the dependency entry under `"dependencies"`
2. the entry in `"dsh".profile.bundles`
Then start DSH again. (Removing only the `bundles` entry is enough; keeping the dependency line avoi
ain. (Removing only the `bundles` entry is enough; keeping the dependency line avoids a re-resolve.)
编辑 `~/.dsh/profiles/<你的 profile>/package.json`，删掉 `dsh-qoder-input` 的两行登记（`dependencies` 里一行、`dsh.pr
ofile.bundles` 里一行），再启动 DSH 即可。只删 `bundles` 那行就足够恢复启动。
## Features / 功能
### 1. ✨ Enhance prompt / 增强提示词（已验证 / verified）
A `✨` button in the composer's right-hand toolbar (`conversation.input.right`).

- Disabled while the draft is empty.
- Click it: the current draft is sent to `/api/qoder-input.enha
nce`, rewritten by the host LLM with the **currently selected session model**, and written back into

the composer.
- The button turns into **「撤销增强」/ Undo enhance** for 15 seconds — one click restores
e button turns into **「撤销增强」/ Undo enhance** for 15 seconds — one click restores the original draft.
输入框为空时按钮置灰；点击后把当前草稿交给宿主模型改写并写回输入框；15 秒内可点「撤销增强」还原原文。
### 2. Voice-draft auto clean-up / 语音转写自动去口语化（实验性 / experimental）
An `conversation.input.overlay` effect that watches the draft and, when a **single large insertion**
appears (previous frame empty → new frame ≥ 20 characters), calls `/api/qoder-input.polish` and wri
tes the cleaned text back.
- Typing character by character does **not** trigger it (by design: previous frame is never empty).
- This path is **experimental**: the button above has been exercised end-to-end; the auto clean-up p
ath has not been regression-tested against real speech-to-text input in every case.
这条链路按「一次性写入 ≥20 字」判定语音转写，逐字打字不会触发。标记为**实验性**：按钮功能已端到端验证，自动整理尚未在各种真实语音场景下逐一回归。
## Install / 安装
From the DSH plugin market (once listed), or via CLI:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then **fully quit and restart DSH** (this plugin's profile has HMR disabled).
安装后需要**完全退出并重启** DSH。
## How it works / 实现
Host half (`lib/index.js`):

- `POST /api/qoder-input.enhance` — rewrites a draft into a more precise, executable prompt.
- `POST
/api/qoder-input.polish` — turns a voice transcript into clean text (removes filler words, repetiti

ons, self-corrections).
- Both call `ctx.llm.stream(...)` with the session's selected model, collect

`text-delta` frames, and return `{ ok, value: { text, changed } }`.
- Failures are returned as `{ c
hanged: false, degraded: true }` — the draft is left untouched instead of showing an error.
Client half (`lib/client.js`):

- Registers the `✨` button into `conversation.input.right` (list slot, `id` + `order`).
- Registers

the auto clean-up effect into `conversation.input.overlay`.
- Subscribes to the composer draft with
`useInput(selector)` and writes back with `inputActions.setDraft(...)`.
## Notes / 说明

- No API keys, no telemetry, no network calls other than the host's own LLM route.
- Requires a work
ing model route in DSH. If the default route is unavailable, requests degrade silently and the draft

is unchanged.
- 不需要任何 API key，不上报数据；除宿主自己的模型调用外不发任何网络请求。
